patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — OpenCart and Saleor share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — OpenCart and Saleor share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose OpenCart only if your buying job matches “GPL open-source PHP cart — free download core; optional managed cloud cited ~$59–$99/mo by” rather than Saleor's shape. Choose Saleor only if your buying job matches “Headless GraphQL commerce — OSS self-host free; Cloud Select $1599/mo, Volume $3999/mo, En” rather than OpenCart's shape. Workflow advantage differs because OpenCart is shaped for GPL open-source PHP cart — free download core; optional managed cloud  whereas Saleor is shaped for Headless GraphQL commerce — OSS self-host free; Cloud Select $1599/mo,. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — OpenCart and Saleor share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: OpenCart is GPL open-source PHP cart — free download core; optional managed cloud cited ~$59–$99/mo by secondary sources (confirm live). WooCommerce kee; Saleor is Headless GraphQL commerce — OSS self-host free; Cloud Select $1599/mo, Volume $3999/mo, Enterprise quote. Forever Free is non-commercial onl.
- Company-size focus: OpenCart (small-business, mid-market) vs Saleor (mid-market, enterprise).
- Researched limits: OpenCart — Hosting, security, and extension TCO are on you even when the license is $0; Saleor — Cloud Select floor ($1599/mo) is high versus WooCommerce hosting TCO.

Limitations — OpenCart: Hosting, security, and extension TCO are on you even when the license is $0; Managed cloud floors are not first-party confirmed here — confirm live before budgeting; Saleor: Cloud Select floor ($1599/mo) is high versus WooCommerce hosting TCO; Forever Free Cloud is non-commercial — not a production merchant free plan.

Poor-fit cases: OpenCart is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Hosting, security, and extension TCO are on you even when the license is $0 · Saleor is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Cloud Select floor ($1599/mo) is high versus WooCommerce hosting TCO · Avoid OpenCart if you actually need Saleor's motion (Headless GraphQL commerce — OSS self-host free; Cloud Select $1599/mo, Volume $3)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
